name: Snowfield
desc: Isolation and endurance - a blank page where every mark anyone makes shows.
tags: scenery, no humans, snow field, unbroken snow, wind carved snow drifts, bare black trees, overcast white sky, blowing snow, animal tracks in snow, faint horizon
prose: an open snowfield of unbroken white, wind-carved drifts and a few bare black trees, the overcast sky nearly the same white as the ground so the horizon almost disappears
note: White on white gives the model nothing to draw, so it fills the emptiness with mountains and chalets. Bare black trees, drift edges and tracks are the few marks that keep it legible while staying empty. Watch the grade: this frame already sits near clipping, so anything lifting brightness eats the drift shadows and the image goes to blank paper.
